riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The live environment is the heart of the work. You set up the equipment, tune the sound, and monitor the stream. A presenter saying the production was completely stable after the event can make the effort worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest appeal is the live setting. When a concert runs without a fault, the music starts, and the lights come down, the technician behind the mixing console knows the sound is exactly as intended. That sense of controlling the production from backstage is deeply satisfying.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Realistic R + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最上头的就是「现场」两个字：设备是你搭的、声音是你调的、直播是你盯的，散场后主播一句「今天太稳了」，比啥都值。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带感的是「现场感」：一场演唱会从头到尾没出岔子，音乐响起、灯光落下，你站在调音台后面，知道这个声音是你要的，那种「幕后操盘」的感觉很上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 现实型 R + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines attention to detail + calmness + commitment to front-line healthcare. Accurate data and steady coordination help physicians save lives.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops calm attention to detail. Technologists must understand cardiac anatomy and equipment while remaining steady and accurate in procedure rooms. It suits resilient people who want front-line healthcare work and value helping physicians save lives.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and helping others (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 冷静 + 愿在医疗一线」凑一块的人——数据准、配合稳，帮医生把命救回来。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「冷静里的细致」——既要懂心脏解剖和仪器，也要在手术间稳得住、报得准。适合细致、抗压、愿在医疗一线的人，也享受「帮医生把命救回来」的价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、实干、也助人（研究 I + 现实 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people whose hands move quickly but whose judgment is even more exacting. You are not making something temporary; you are building work meant to stand for decades.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying moment comes when the job is finished and you look back. The stair railing, cabinet, or formwork you built is a tangible object that can serve people for decades. A craftsperson's greatest pride is letting the work speak for itself.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手比脑子快、但心比手更细」的人——你做的不是快活，是能站几十年的活。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的时刻是「活干完了回头看」：你做的楼梯扶手、打的柜子、支的模板，是实实在在能用几十年的东西——手艺人最大的骄傲，是作品替自己说话。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine numerical accuracy, composure, and respectful service. Documents must be correct, communication tactful, and rules enforced consistently.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Accuracy is the hardest standard in this work. Every form must match and every rule must be verified, because one missing item can stop a case that day. The role suits steady people who remember rules and remain patient with repetitive work. Courteous communication is also a core requirement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers structured, rule-driven work and interacting with people (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「数字准 + 性子稳 + 会待人」凑一块的人——材料要对，话要软，规矩要硬。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「准」——每一份表格都要对得上，每一条规则都要核得清，差一项当天就办不成。适合性子稳、记规则、能在重复里保持耐心的人，跟人沟通的礼貌也是硬指标。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿意和人打交道（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Criminal Justice And Law Enforcement Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine research, communication, and education. Procedures must be clear, students need effective guidance, and faculty must balance research with teaching while upholding ethical boundaries.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops the ability to explain practice clearly. Faculty must clarify complex policing and justice procedures while addressing students' career concerns. It suits people who enjoy research, communicate well, and want to educate others, including those who value seeing students enter the profession.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research, helping others, and leadership (Social S + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 高校刑事司法与执法教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「研究 + 表达 + 育人」凑一块的人——流程要讲清、学生要带住、科研和教学要平衡也要守底线。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把实务讲透」——要把警务与司法的复杂流程讲清，也要接住学生的职业困惑。适合爱研究、表达强、愿意育人的人，也享受看着学生进系统的那一下。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、助人、也主导（社会 S + 探究 I + 经营 E）。

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Farming, Fishing, And Forestry Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who understand production and lead others. They can work in the field and organize a team effectively.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This role feels like field command. A crew follows your plan, and you keep work and people organized while controlling harvest and schedule. The sense of practical control is substantial.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 农林渔业工人一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「既懂生产、又会带人」的人——能在田头干活，也能把团队组织得井井有条。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行有种「田头将军」的感觉：一队人跟着你干，你把活排明白、把人带顺，收成和进度都在你手里，这种掌控感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Food Servers, Nonrestaurant are worth considering if you remain curious about the occupation and accept judgment under moderate risk.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops situational awareness. Servers must remember table numbers and avoid mistakes while moving through a venue. It suits quick, attentive people with good memory who remain comfortable in front of guests.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical service, business pace, and interaction (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Food Servers, Nonrestaurant有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，非餐厅食品服务员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「眼观六路」——既要记桌号，也要在走动里不出错。适合腿脚利索、记性好、不怯场的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手服务、也讲经营节奏、重互动（现实 R + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Gambling Surveillance Officers And Gambling Investigators

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation combines attention to detail, composure, and respect for rules. Anomalies require accurate detection and deep investigation, balanced with patience and strict procedure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops calm observation. Professionals detect anomalies across many screens and patiently follow leads to a conclusion. It suits careful, steady people who respect rules and enjoy uncovering facts from small clues.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, investigative, and conventional interests (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 稳重 + 规则感」凑一块的人——异常要看得准也要追得深，观察和耐心要平衡也要守规矩。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「冷静的观察力」——要能在满屏画面里抓异常，也沉得住气把一条线索追到底。适合细心、稳重、对规则敏感的人，也享受从蛛丝马迹挖出真相的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究、也讲规矩（企业 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine hands-on ability, visual judgment, and resilience under pressure. Lighting must be both precise and attractive, and technicians must balance console work with live improvisation.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops both practiced touch and visual judgment. Technicians master DMX consoles while understanding color temperature and composition. It suits people who can focus at a console, care deeply about the image, and enjoy taking a performance from blackout to highlight.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, artistic, and enterprising (Realistic R + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 眼力 + 抗压」凑一块的人——灯要打准也要打美，控台和现场要平衡也要会临场。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感和眼力」——既要把 DMX 控台玩得顺，也要懂色温和构图。适合坐得住控台、又对画面有执念的人，也享受把一场演出从黑场打到高光的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、也艺术（现实 R + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Metal Refining Furnace Operators And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines practicality, steadiness, and resilience. Furnaces must remain stable and tap accurately while temperature and safety stay balanced.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops composure under heat. Workers interpret furnace conditions and instruments while maintaining rhythm in demanding environments. It suits practical people who take responsibility for safety and quality.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, structured, and precise work (Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 稳重 + 能抗压」凑一块的人——炉要看得稳也要出得准，温度和安全要平衡也要会守。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「温度里的定力」——既要看懂炉况和仪表，也要在高热环境里稳住节奏。适合务实、坐得住、又愿意对安全和质量负责的人，也享受从点火到出钢的完整过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守规、也重精确（现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who find fulfillment in quiet work. Watching a damaged object slowly recover in your hands creates a tangible connection through time, one of the occupation's most precious rewards.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling part of this field is physically touching history. A damaged bronze regains its form in your hands, and a faded ancient painting recovers its vitality. No spreadsheet can provide that sense of connection across time.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Investigative I + Realistic R

breadcrumb.label: 博物馆技术员与文物修复师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「能在安静里找到满足」的人——一件残缺的器物在手里慢慢恢复原貌，那种亲手接通时间的感觉，是这份工作最珍贵的回馈。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「亲手触摸历史」：一件残破的青铜器在你手上恢复轮廓，一幅褪色的古画重新显出神采——这种穿越时间的连接感，是任何表格数据给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 研究型 I + 现实型 R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people more comfortable working with their hands than talking. Drawing interpretation can be learned, but steady control of a welding torch develops through practice.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most grounded part of this field is visible craftsmanship. Pipes you install remain aligned and leak-free, and ten years later people can still praise the original technician's work. This visible achievement is difficult to find in office buildings.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 管道工、配管工与蒸汽管安装工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「动手比动嘴舒服」的人——图纸看不懂可以学，但手上那把焊枪的稳，是练出来的本事。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的地方是「手艺肉眼可见」——你布的水管不会漏、对得齐，十年后还有人夸当初那个老师傅干活漂亮。这种看得见的成就感，写字楼里很难找到。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most valuable reward is witnessing human change. Watching clients gradually emerge from distress and regain control of their lives brings a sense of purpose that many high-paying jobs cannot provide.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest weight of this career comes from accompanying someone as they regain their footing. Watching a client move from depression in the first session to moving forward independently months later makes witnessing change the profession's deepest reward.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最珍贵的回报是「见证人的改变」：看到来访者从困顿里慢慢走出来，重新掌控自己的生活——这种职业带来的意义感，是许多高薪岗位给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有分量的是「陪一个人重新站起来」：从第一次咨询时的低沉，到几个月后能自己往前走，那种见证改变的过程，是这个职业最深的回报。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most absorbing part is obtaining results through field persistence. Raising a warehouse's read rate from 70% to 99% can come from moving two antennas and switching to one tag type. Solving seemingly mysterious field problems provides tangible, evidence-based satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most interesting part is making invisible things visible. Tags attach to goods, clothing, and surgical instruments. Once you tune read distance and remove interference, every item in a warehouse gains a digital identity, creating a distinctive connection between physical objects and data.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最上头的是「现场死磕出结果」：一个仓库的读取率从 70% 调到 99%，可能是因为你挪了两根天线、换了一类标签——把看似玄学的现场问题搞定，这种实证的成就感很有分量。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「让看不见的东西被看见」：标签贴在货物、衣服、手术器械上，你在现场把读写距离调好、把干扰排掉，仓库里的每一件东西从此有了数字身份——这种「打通物理与数据」的感觉很特别。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, And Samplers, Recordkeeping

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy seeing numbers reconcile. The moment inventory and records align feels as satisfying as watching a phone battery change from red to green.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest sense of certainty comes when records match inventory. Before leaving, every system number aligns, no shipment is missing, and no entry differs. Only then is the day truly complete.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Conventional C + Realistic R + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢数字对得上」的人——账货相符的那一下，跟你手机电量从红变绿一样舒坦。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最大的踏实感是「账货相符」——下班前系统里数字都对得上，一票货没漏、一笔账没差，这一天才算真过完。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 事务型 C + 实际型 R + 社会型 S
